newsitem.title: USA: Kmart to get $90 mln from Mexican sale.
newsitem.headline: Kmart to get $90 mln from Mexican sale.

text.p: Kmart Corp said it will receive a total of $90 million in cash and tax benefits from the sale of its Mexican retail joint venture.

Previously, Kmart had said it would receive $74.25 million in cash from the sale of Kmart Mexico SA de CV to Mexican retail group Controladora Comercial Mexicana SA de CV, a deal with a total cash value of $148.5 million.
Kmart's former partner in the five-store venture, El Puerto de Liverpool SA de CV, also will get $74.25 million in the deal.

"The sale of Kmart Mexico is consistent with our commitment to improve our overall financial performance by focusing on the core business - our traditional Kmart stores and Super Kmart Centers," Kmart Chairman Floyd Hall said in a statement.
